info.title: DharmaDarshan - Astrology & Customer Management API
info.description: Production-ready, developer-ready REST API for DharmaDarshan mobile OTP authentication, customer profile management, multiple birth profiles, customer wallet balance, preferences, sessions, and security lifecycle. Powered by Node.js, Express, Prisma, and PostgreSQL (Supabase).
